recipes.purpose: Turn a raw idea into a complete optimized Flash-UI prompt.
recipes.instruction: Reorganize this idea into a complete build prompt with audience, pages, interactions, design direction, constraints, and deliverables. Preserve the source intent and mark unknowns.

recipes.purpose: Generate a Flash-UI prompt for a conversion-focused landing page.
recipes.instruction: Shape a conversion page with a clear offer, proof needs, objections, accessible sections, and one primary action. Do not invent proof.

recipes.purpose: Generate a Flash-UI prompt for an interactive tool, calculator, quiz, checklist, or assessment.
recipes.instruction: Specify user inputs, validation, core logic, outputs, edge cases, and a useful next action for an interactive tool.

recipes.purpose: Generate a Flash-UI prompt for a dashboard or command center interface.
recipes.instruction: Define the primary decisions, data states, hierarchy, filters, responsive layout, and empty/loading/error states for a dashboard.

recipes.purpose: Generate a Flash-UI prompt for an embeddable widget.
recipes.instruction: Describe an embeddable interface, host constraints, sizing, configuration, accessibility, and a standalone fallback.

recipes.purpose: Convert a Flash-UI concept into repo-ready project guidance.
recipes.instruction: Turn the concept into a repository plan with file structure, setup, tests, and local run instructions. Do not claim a repository already exists.

recipes.purpose: Add monetization strategy to an existing Flash-UI project prompt.
recipes.instruction: Evaluate optional revenue paths, pricing assumptions, conversion points, and measurement needs. Label every unverified assumption.
Identify vague requirements, missing states, accessibility gaps, and implementation risks, then revise the working instructions.

recipes.purpose: Generate multiple prompt directions from one idea.
recipes.instruction: Propose three distinct design or product directions, with tradeoffs and a recommended starting point.

recipes.purpose: Remove vague language from a prompt.
recipes.instruction: Replace vague claims with observable behaviors, explicit acceptance criteria, and concrete interface copy.

recipes.purpose: Align a Flash-UI prompt with a specific brand or business ecosystem.
recipes.instruction: Align tone, visual choices, audience, and actions with the specified brand. Keep unknown brand rules as open questions.

recipes.purpose: Optimize a prompt for static HTML/CSS/JS or static deployability.
recipes.instruction: Constrain the implementation to static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Identify which features require a backend and provide local-only fallbacks.
